title: console build on macOS: @object-ui/i18n fails TS2339 at packNamespace.ts:302 (I18nContext read as {})
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAm8Y73VGNq3PkTe3dc

Filing gate: ① defect with a named location and a reproduction, and ③ maintainer direct dispatch · Source: maintainer

The maintainer ran the #36777 acceptance on a Mac and sent the output to this account's fleet project, twice (2026-11-24 ~15:22Z, and ~15:37Z after the seat asked for a clean reinstall), with the seat's standing offer 「还失败的话把输出发我，我立缺陷卡派人修」 answered by the second run. Verbatim excerpt of the second run:

> ```
> @object-ui/i18n:build: src/namespaces/packNamespace.ts:302:48 - error TS2339: Property 'i18n' does not exist on type'{}'.
> @object-ui/i18n:build: 302     const instance = (useContext(I18nContext)?.i18n ?? getI18n()) as I18nInstance | undefined;
> Tasks:    22 successful, 25 total
> Cached:    22 cached, 25 total
> Failed:    @object-ui/i18n#build
> ```
> `node -v` → `v26.7.0`

## What happens

`pnpm console:build` on macOS stops at `@object-ui/i18n#build` (`tsc`): `useContext(I18nContext)` is typed `{}` there, so `.i18n` does not exist. The console cannot be built on a Mac, and #36777 (the Mac acceptance of #36753) cannot complete.

## What the seat measured (Linux, not the Mac)

- `origin/main` 4c4a6777, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (pnpm 10.31.0, the `packageManager` pin), then `pnpm turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/i18n`: **passes**, 5/5 tasks.
- The lockfile holds one `react-i18next` (17.0.11; its `index.d.ts:312` declares `I18nContext: React.Context<{ i18n: i18n }>`) and one `@types/react` (19.3.0).
- `react-i18next`'s typings import `react`, but the package does not depend on `@types/react`; in the pnpm store, `node_modules/.pnpm/react-i18next@17.0.11…/node_modules/` holds no `@types/react`. On Linux the import resolves only through pnpm's hidden hoist, `node_modules/.pnpm/node_modules/@types/react`. Hypothesis, NOT verified on a Mac: where that hoist is absent (another pnpm major or a user-level `hoist` setting; the maintainer's `pnpm` is a user install, version unread), `React.Context` does not resolve and `useContext` infers `{}`. Node 26.7.0 against `engines.node >=22` is a second difference, not a likely cause for a type error.

## Expected

`pnpm console:build` passes on macOS from a clean checkout, and the i18n package's type check does not depend on pnpm's hidden hoisting.

## For the dev (questions, not fences)

- Confirm or falsify the hoist hypothesis on Linux: install with the hoist disabled (e.g. `--config.hoist=false`, or the pnpm major the maintainer has) and build `@object-ui/i18n`. A reproduction on Linux is the regression test's base.
- Fix at the root: the package should read the context with types it owns or a dependency it declares, not a phantom hoist. Whether that is a typed local read, a declared `@types/react` resolution, or a workspace `public-hoist-pattern`, is the dev's reading; name what else in `ui/**` imports a third-party React context the same way (`grep -rn "useContext(" ui/packages --include=*.ts*`) and cover the whole family.
- Acceptance: the hoist-disabled Linux build passes; then the maintainer re-runs #36777 on the Mac.

Business reason: every developer on a Mac (the maintainer included) cannot build the console; #36777 stays open until it can.
Reader who acts: seat `repo:objectstack#2` (area f2-F, lease extended to `ui/packages/i18n/**`), on the maintainer's direct dispatch.
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue is:open packNamespace` → 1 hit (#36777, the acceptance card this blocks, not a fix); `is:issue is:open TS2339 I18nContext` → 1 hit (the same). Parent context: #36753 (closed, p1, area:build).
Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none
Grade: area:build · Bug · broken × developers building the console on macOS, the same reach that graded #36753 p1 → p1.
